# Game Idea: Orbit Escape

- Playable in an HTML canvas.
- Control a spaceship that orbits a central planet.
- Asteroids are launched from the edges toward the planet.
- Press space (or click) to change orbit radius to dodge incoming asteroids.
- Lose condition: collision with an asteroid or falling into the planet.

1: // Simple Orbit Escape game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Audio setup
8:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
9:   function playBeep(freq = 440, duration = 0.1) {
10:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:     osc.type = 'sine';
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.connect(gain);
15:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
18:     gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
19:     osc.start();
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
21:   }
22:   function playExplosion() {
23:     const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * 0.2;
24:     const noiseBuf = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
25:     const output = noiseBuf.getChannelData(0);
26:     for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
27:       output[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
28:     }
29:     const noise = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
30:     noise.buffer = noiseBuf;
31:     const filter = audioCtx.createBiquadFilter();
32:     filter.type = 'lowpass';
33:     filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(1000, audioCtx.currentTime);
34:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
35:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5, audioCtx.currentTime);
36:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
37:     noise.connect(filter);
38:     filter.connect(gain);
39:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
40:     noise.start();
41:     noise.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
42:   }
43:   const w = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth);
44:   const h = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight);
45:   // Starfield setup
46:   const starCount = 100;
47:   const stars = [];
48:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
49:     stars.push({
50:       x: Math.random() * w,
51:       y: Math.random() * h,
52:       brightness: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
53:     });
54:   }
55: 
56:   const center = { x: w / 2, y: h / 2 };
57:   const planet = { r: 30 };
58:   const ship = {
59:     angle: 0,
60:     radius: 120,
61:     innerRadius: 80,
62:     outerRadius: 140,
63:     size: 8,
64:     speed: 0.02,
65:   };
66:   const asteroids = [];
67:   let lastSpawn = 0;
68:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
69:   let gameOver = false;
70: 
71:   function spawnAsteroid() {
72:     // Choose random edge
73:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
74:     let x, y, vx, vy;
75:     const speed = 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.5;
76:     if (side === 0) {
77:       // top
78:       x = Math.random() * w;
79:       y = -10;
80:     } else if (side === 1) {
81:       // right
82:       x = w + 10;
83:       y = Math.random() * h;
84:     } else if (side === 2) {
85:       // bottom
86:       x = Math.random() * w;
87:       y = h + 10;
88:     } else {
89:       // left
90:       x = -10;
91:       y = Math.random() * h;
92:     }
93:     // Vector towards center
94:     const dx = center.x - x;
95:     const dy = center.y - y;
96:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
97:     vx = (dx / len) * speed;
98:     vy = (dy / len) * speed;
99:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 6, color: '#'+Math.floor(Math.random()*16777215).toString(16) });
100:   }
101: 
102:   function update(dt) {
103:     if (gameOver) return;
104:     // Ship orbit
105:     ship.angle += ship.speed * dt;
106:     // Toggle radius on input handled elsewhere
107:     // Update asteroids
108:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
109:       const a = asteroids[i];
110:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
111:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
112:       // Remove if near center
113:       if (Math.hypot(a.x - center.x, a.y - center.y) < planet.r) {
114:         playExplosion();
115:         gameOver = true;
116:         return;
117:       }
118:       // Collision with ship
119:       const shipPos = {
120:         x: center.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius,
121:         y: center.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius,
122:       };
123:       if (Math.hypot(a.x - shipPos.x, a.y - shipPos.y) < a.r + ship.size) {
124:         gameOver = true;
125:         return;
126:       }
127:     }
128:     // Spawn new asteroid
129:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
130:       spawnAsteroid();
131:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
132:     }
133:   }
134: 
135:   function draw() {
136:     // Draw starfield background
137:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
138:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
139:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
140:     stars.forEach(s => {
141:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.brightness;
142:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
143:     });
144:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
145: 
146:     // Planet with radial gradient
147:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(center.x, center.y, planet.r * 0.2, center.x, center.y, planet.r);
148:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#6b8e23');
149:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2b3b4b');
150:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
151:     ctx.beginPath();
152:     ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
153:     ctx.fill();
154: 
155:     // Ship as triangle pointing forward
156:     const shipPos = {
157:       x: center.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius,
158:       y: center.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius,
159:     };
160:     const dir = ship.angle;
161:     const tip = { x: shipPos.x + Math.cos(dir) * ship.size * 2, y: shipPos.y + Math.sin(dir) * ship.size * 2 };
162:     const left = { x: shipPos.x + Math.cos(dir + Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.size, y: shipPos.y + Math.sin(dir + Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.size };
163:     const right = { x: shipPos.x + Math.cos(dir - Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.size, y: shipPos.y + Math.sin(dir - Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.size };
164:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
165:     ctx.beginPath();
166:     ctx.moveTo(tip.x, tip.y);
167:     ctx.lineTo(left.x, left.y);
168:     ctx.lineTo(right.x, right.y);
169:     ctx.closePath();
170:     ctx.fill();
171: 
172:     // Asteroids with varied colors
173:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
174:       ctx.fillStyle = a.color || '#888';
175:       ctx.beginPath();
176:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
177:       ctx.fill();
178:     });
179: 
180:     if (gameOver) {
181:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
182:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
183:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
184:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
185:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
186:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', w / 2, h / 2);
187:     }
188:   }
189:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
190:     // Planet
191:     ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3b4b';
192:     ctx.beginPath();
193:     ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
194:     ctx.fill();
195:     // Ship
196:     const shipPos = {
197:       x: center.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.radius,
198:       y: center.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.radius,
199:     };
200:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
201:     ctx.beginPath();
202:     ctx.arc(shipPos.x, shipPos.y, ship.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
203:     ctx.fill();
204:     // Asteroids
205:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
206:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
207:       ctx.beginPath();
208:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
209:       ctx.fill();
210:     });
211:     if (gameOver) {
212:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
213:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
214:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
215:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
216:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
217:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', w / 2, h / 2);
218:     }
219:   }
220: 
221:   let lastTime = performance.now();
222:   function loop() {
223:     const now = performance.now();
224:     const dt = (now - lastTime) / 16; // normalize to ~60fps steps
225:     lastTime = now;
226:     update(dt);
227:     draw();
228:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
229:   }
230: 
231:   // Input: space or click toggles between inner and outer orbit radius
232:   function toggleRadius() {
233:     // Ensure audio context is running
234:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
235:     playBeep(600, 0.07);
236:     ship.radius = ship.radius === ship.innerRadius ? ship.outerRadius : ship.innerRadius;
237:     ship.radius = ship.radius === ship.innerRadius ? ship.outerRadius : ship.innerRadius;
238:   }
239:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
240:     if (e.code === 'Space') toggleRadius();
241:   });
242:   canvas.addEventListener('click', toggleRadius);
243: 
244:   // Start
245:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
246: })();

(End of file - total 246 lines)
